title: Stronger Talents
notes: Talent points feel stronger early: the first 3 ranks of every talent count double, Sharp Blade and Tough give more.
Each talent shows what the next point really gives you, e.g. 'Next: +8 ATK (+59 Power)'.
Training Tower monsters wear the colours of their place, vary in size and often carry affixes with glowing auras: Giant, Shadow, Vampiric, Blazing, Armored, Swift (more rewards).
Tower floor modifiers are now truly mixed.
